params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: Every trend currently carries only Gen Z. The brief asks to derive generation (Gen Z, ZAlpha, Gen Alpha) and life stage from the trend's signals.

Backlog item from the brief: not for this pass, a separate ticket. Each trend should carry the generations and life stages its signals show, so the filters on the site and the trend pages say who it is about.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Derive generation and life stage per trend from its signals
